en: The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard depicting part of a historic building largely covered in ivy, with multiple windows and a sloped roof. In the background, a pointed church-like spire rises above the structure. There is a garden or landscaped area in the foreground. The text at the top left reads 'Schlettau i. Erzgeb. Schloss.' in red, and some smaller red text is visible at the bottom of the image.
